findings.evidence: Relaxing Question.skill to nullable (for new PTE questions) left publishQuestion/uploadAudio still branching on the deprecated skill field to decide audio-prompt requirements — for a PTE question with skill=null, publishQuestion silently skipped the audio-required check and uploadAudio always rejected the upload.
findings.why_it_matters: Would have made audio-prompt-bearing PTE task types (Repeat Sentence, Re-tell Lecture, Answer Short Question, all 8 Listening types) impossible to author correctly through the API.
findings.required_action: Added requiresAudioPrompt(boolean) per PteTaskType constant + a QuestionService.requiresAudioPrompt(Question) helper that prefers pteTaskType when set, falling back to the legacy skill-based check for APTIS-era questions.

findings.evidence: Original PteTaskType enum was built on a 20-scored-item-type assumption; Pearson's official Score Guide (July 2025) and PTE-changes articles confirm 22 scored item types as of the August 2025 update (RESPOND_TO_A_SITUATION, SUMMARIZE_GROUP_DISCUSSION added, purely additive).
findings.why_it_matters: Would have shipped a domain model 2 task types short of the real current exam, discovered only much later once Phase 8 UI or Phase 2 timing work was already built around 20.
findings.required_action: Added both enum constants (AI_SCORED, requiresAudioPrompt=true), PteTaskTypeSkillMapping entries, DTO regex updates; re-verified 235/235 tests green. Reviewed separately by quality-reviewer (PASS) for this specific diff.
